h2: NDT training near Midland, Texas: Permian Basin colleges, inspection-company hiring and online study compared
html:
NDT training near Midland, Texas: Permian Basin colleges, inspection-company hiring and online study compared

In the Permian Basin most NDT technicians are trained by the companies that hire them. Midland College and Odessa College both run established welding programmes, but neither lists an NDT method course, and the nearest full NDT programme we verified is Amarillo College, a long drive north in the Panhandle. So the honest near-me answer in Midland is mostly about employers: who trains assistants, what they expect to see, and how to get classroom hours on paper while working rotations.

Who offers NDT training around Midland?

  • Midland College. The welding programme at the main campus on North Garfield offers an AAS, certificates and continuing-education courses in stick, MIG, TIG, flux-cored and oxy-fuel work on carbon and stainless plate and pipe, with blueprint reading and metallurgy. Inspection is listed as a career area, but no NDT course content is listed.
  • Odessa College. An AAS in Welding and a General Welder Level 1 Certificate, with inspection and quality-control techniques in the degree and AWS CWI, CWE and CWS preparation in continuing education. The college also says it can deliver specialised training at an employer's site. Useful for a welder heading toward weld inspection; it is not NDT method training.
  • Amarillo College. A full NDT programme with an AAS and certificates covering visual, magnetic particle, penetrant, radiographic, ultrasonic and eddy current testing, with evening classes and fall or spring starts. The college says it also helps working technicians update their skills to meet ASNT requirements.
  • Inspection companies. An Acuren posting for an RT Level II technician in Midland preferred candidates within about 50 miles of Midland–Odessa and asked for 40-hour radiation safety training, Texas radiographer card or trainee status, a TWIC card, and copies of certifications and classroom documentation. The same Level II was expected to give on-the-job guidance to assistants and Level I technicians, which is how most Permian newcomers enter the trade.
  • A union route for oil and gas. IUOE Local 112, an Operating Engineers local, says it trains NDT personnel and supplies them to oil and gas contractors across the country, a fit for pipeline and gathering work out of Midland.

Which Midland route fits you?

Your situationRoute that usually fitsWhat to watch
No NDT job yet, staying in MidlandAn assistant job with an inspection company, with method theory studied on days offClassroom hours must be documented, as the Acuren posting shows
Welder at Midland or Odessa CollegeFinish welding, then add VT, MT or UT method training or CWI prepWelding credentials and NDT certifications are separate
Ready to move for a full programmeAmarillo CollegeTime away from Permian wages
Midland employer certifying a crewOn-site training at the yard with Level III-administered examsFitting exams around rotations

Questions to ask any NDT training provider near Midland

  • Will the paperwork stand up? Permian employers ask for copies of classroom records. Does the course issue a record with method, level, topics and hours?
  • Do the hours meet SNT-TC-1A? Check the method and level totals with the SNT-TC-1A hours planner.
  • Can you study on rotation? Fourteen-on, seven-off schedules rule out fixed weekly classes for many Midland technicians.
  • Who certifies? Your employer certifies you under its written practice; ASNT certifies only after its central exams.
  • Radiography? Texas radiographer credentials through DSHS and a radiation safety course come on top of any NDT method course.
  • Level III access? Who answers questions while you study in Midland, Odessa or a man camp?

Where Atlantis fits for Midland candidates and employers

The Atlantis route is built for people who cannot sit in a weekly class. Theory is studied online on the Atlantis portal on days off or between hitches, an ASNT NDT Level III answers questions, and access opens the day you enrol. Practice comes in the Practical NDT simulator; the hands-on practical and the practical exam happen at your employer's yard or shop on its equipment, under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, and your employer issues the certification. For Permian work start with NDT Level 1 in UT or MT, then Level 2; RT candidates can add radiographic testing theory alongside their state radiographer requirements.

Welders aiming at weld inspection can take the six-day AWS CWI exam prep online or at their employer. Midland and Odessa inspection companies building a programme can start with SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up. Nearby pages: Odessa, El Paso and NDT training in Texas.
